page.overview:
Who is F.R.I.D.A.?

(Far-Ranging Integrated Defense Aeormaton) is an Aeormaton fighter/rogue/cleric and a werewolf. F.R.I.D.A. is played by Christian Navarro.

F.R.I.D.A. is a slender emerald green, rose gold-framed Aeormaton with a feminine face and 6-foot tall muscular frame. There is guilloché machined patterning under the enamel on their cladding. When encountered by Bells Hells, they were wearing a very elegant, beautifully designed emerald green trench coat, with the collar up, framing their neck; the coat had Deanna's name embroidered, and more recently, FCG's as well. Their right hand was peeled backward revealing a blunderbuss gun hidden inside their arm. Their right arm was bare, and when FRIDA casts healing magic, an etching of the Dawnfather's symbol lights up.

Their faceplate can be removed by pressing a button on each side of the temple. On the inside, inscribed along the jawline, their full name is written.

F.R.I.D.A. is a dutiful individual that, after discovering that they were intended to protect, focused in that task by keeping their best friend Deanna safe, making her their priority, even if they are also loyal, affectionate and protective around other friends. In a similar way, they are patient and understanding when talking with others, although defending their own posture, like their opinion about the gods. The gunslinger is fascinated by their past in Aeor, having a great desire of learning more and understanding themselves better; because of that, after meeting Fresh Cut Grass F.R.I.D.A. was elated, and the positive feelings towards the other Aeormaton soon developed into a crush.
